sections.title: The Concept: From ODEs to PDEs
lecture_lines: ODEs track change in one variable, like time.
PDEs track change across both space and time.
Think of a point moving on a line.
Contrast this with ripples across a pond's surface.
PDEs capture this complex spatial evolution.

sections.title: Core Mechanism: The Partial Derivative
lecture_lines: Partial derivatives act as a slice of reality.
Vary space while freezing time to see change.
Vary time while freezing space for local change.

sections.title: The Heat Equation: Modeling Diffusion
lecture_lines: The heat equation models how energy spreads.
Visualize heat diffusing through a metal bar.
The center cools as heat moves outward.

sections.title: The Wave Equation: Modeling Oscillation
lecture_lines: The wave equation tracks acceleration and movement.
A guitar string shows space-time interaction.
It models the snap-back force of vibrations.

sections.title: Summary & Real-World Impact
lecture_lines: PDEs are the mathematical language of nature.
They govern everything from weather to finance.
We move from tracking points to fields.
